classificationLegend.Consume: Plumbing that maps to an EXISTING technical-module capability the owning Epic 2 story adopts in place of the hand-rolled local code. Counts toward the plumbing-LOC baseline.
classificationLegend.Promote: Plumbing with no existing shared capability; the owning Epic 3 story extracts/promotes a generic capability and Conversations adopts it. Counts toward the plumbing-LOC baseline.
classificationLegend.Keep: Domain logic, not plumbing to move in this initiative. Excluded from the plumbing-LOC baseline. Keep != frozen (it may still change for domain reasons); it means 'not a boilerplate-reduction move target in this pilot'.

changeLog.rationale: Story 2.2 consumes (deletes) the dead command-status idempotency-bridge shim at src/Hexalith.Conversations.Server/EventStore/EventStoreCommandStatusIdempotencyBridge.cs — the sole .cs file under this area's 'src/Hexalith.Conversations.Server/EventStore/**' path glob (the 'Server/EventStore glue (32)' counted in this Consume row). The shim had zero production references and is redundant under FR-7 (the SDK base class the aggregate already extends owns command status). With that file removed, the glob now resolves to no .cs file. Does 'shared-host-api' remain Consume?
changeLog.resolutionRationale: Upheld — classification stays Consume. Consuming (deleting) a Consume-classified file is the realization of the accepted call, not a reclassification (so from/to do not apply); the area's classification, approxLoc (906), and paths are left byte-unchanged (LOC is frozen at baselineCommit and measured as a reduction by SM-1, never re-measured here). Logged append-only per Story 1.5 classification-change-procedure-v1 so the now-empty 'EventStore/**' glob is an accounted-for consumption, not a stale or mistyped path. Cross-reference: the at-risk-test-register-v1 story22StructuralDispositions records the same removal under FR-7 / Story 2.2.

changeLog.rationale: This area's targetCapability names 'Commons TypeMapper + generic value/identifier JSON converters + source-gen JSON-context base' (capabilityStatus 'existing'). Verified at the recorded Commons gitlink 30620b9: most of that named target does NOT exist as consumable surface. Commons exposes only the public static TypeMapper.GetMap<TMappable>() (plus GetObject / GetType / GetMappableTypes), all constrained where TMappable : IMappableType, and an internal NameTypeMapper<TMappable>. Commons ships NO generic value/identifier JSON converter and NO source-generated JSON-serialization-context base, and Hexalith.PolymorphicSerializations is neither in Central Package Management nor referenced under src/. Conversations contracts do not implement IMappableType, so the one hand-rolled type-name->Type map (ConversationProjectionHandler.BuildPublicEventTypeMap, 13 events keyed by type.Name) cannot adopt TypeMapper.GetMap() without a public-contract reshape (FR-14/3.6 territory). So there is nothing in the Epic-2 (Consume-only, no-Commons-edit) surface to remove-and-replace the 215-LOC generic converters with, and a within-area reclassification finds that the PrefixedIdentifierJsonConverter + the 7 concrete identifier converters encode a genuine cross-type-substitution-prevention domain rule (Keep-aligned), while only the two value-base skeletons are ruleless machinery. Does 'generic-serialization-converters' remain Consume?
changeLog.resolutionRationale: Upheld — classification stays Consume. The consume is not abandoned, it is DEFERRED: building the shared generic-converter / source-gen JSON-context-base capability and publicizing NameTypeMapper is a Promote = FR-14 = Story 3.6, opened as an explicit Epic-3 dependency. Because the eventual consume is deferred rather than realized or relabeled, this is a challenge/upheld note with no from/to (the disposition string is unchanged); the area's classification, approxLoc (215), and paths are left byte-unchanged (LOC is frozen at baselineCommit, never re-measured here), and the paired Keep area's approxLoc (432) is likewise untouched. The within-area reclassification of the prefixed-identifier converters is recorded but does NOT relabel the area (the area remains the FR-8 Consume target as a whole, with its eventual deletion deferred). Logged append-only per Story 1.5 classification-change-procedure-v1 so the re-scope is non-silent (FR-2) and Story 3.6 inherits a clear dependency. Cross-reference: the at-risk-test-register-v1 story26StructuralDispositions records the verified-gap finding, the within-area reclassification, and the AC-2 negative finding under FR-8 / Story 2.6.
